findings.detail: Both local queries return True/0 on the parent. R1 routes them through _find_index and before(0), which performs start + 0 * step under the caller arithmetic context. Even an equal Decimal value can emit Rounded; the narrow overflow handlers do not catch it. The independent iteration policy is not an excuse to break these previously legal queries. No claim is made that the parent iteration is legal with this trap.
findings.smallest_correction: Preserve baseline-legal local-query exception semantics and avoid introducing unnecessary arithmetic that triggers caller traps; verify the actual changed query path with an independent expected result.
